scientific_integrity: The method and positivity guarantee belong to the cited source; the new claim is the precise three-root scalar classification with asymptotics. Analytical proof and exact-rational checker are supplied.

All h x²≥20, not a sharp onset threshold

title: Three dissipative implicit branches of the fourth-order exponential AVF step on a convex quartic
